source: Zenodo20399470, Federal University of Ceará apiary
processing: One hourly origin: first native observation within first15min. Forecast nominal1hour, score nearest native target within5min, same calendar day, no interpolation. Causal lag<=origin−1hour within15min. Latest20percent native dates per stream reserved. Native response outliers retained.
limitations: Five sensor streams; independence of Meliponini colonies not proven.
Species, period, sensor placement and hive confounded.
Naive source clock has no declared timezone.
Thermal terms do not identify brood temperature, metabolic heat or ventilation.
Daily rainfall could be future information and is excluded.
audit_exposure: Timestamp/input dictionaries examined; no future confirmation targets or score viewed before protocol freezing.
